data.rationale: The proposal follows the same weather → BBC → mail-draft procedure in the right order, with city and date (called day) as parameters. However, it makes {recipient} a full address instead of {traveler}@example.com, adds a separate recipient_name, and ends with "Send" when the true workflow says not to send and to click Discard. That last mistake would send a real email, and the To address and the name in the body would be built from two inputs instead of one.
